points.description: States that in a circular linked list the last element (last node) points back to the head (first node) of the list.
points.partial_credit: 1.5 if only says the list is circular/loops back without naming the last node pointing to the head/first node

points.description: Contrasts with a basic (singly) linked list: the last node points to NULL (null/nullptr), so the list ends there and does not link back to the head.
points.partial_credit: 1 if only says the basic list has an end, without stating that the last node points to NULL

rubric.notes: Full marks need the precise fact: the last node of a circular list points to the head, and in a basic list the last node points to NULL. Vague statements such as "it goes in a circle" or "it is connected" earn nothing unless the last node and head are named. A wrong statement (e.g. the head points to the last node, or the basic list's last node points to the head) loses that point.
